name: retro2003
description: 用 2003 年的互联网形态复刻今天的主流产品：小红书 2003、淘宝网 2003

scripts.setup: npm --prefix sites/xhs2003 install && npm --prefix sites/taobao2003 install
scripts.dev:xhs: SEED_DEMO=true ADMIN_USERNAME=站长 ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-retro2003-demo-admin} npm --prefix sites/xhs2003 run dev
scripts.dev:taobao: SEED_DEMO=true ADMIN_USERNAME=淘宝小二 ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-retro2003-demo-admin} npm --prefix sites/taobao2003 run dev
scripts.start:xhs: SEED_DEMO=true ADMIN_USERNAME=站长 ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-retro2003-demo-admin} npm --prefix sites/xhs2003 start
scripts.start:taobao: SEED_DEMO=true ADMIN_USERNAME=淘宝小二 ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-retro2003-demo-admin} npm --prefix sites/taobao2003 start
scripts.test: npm --prefix sites/xhs2003 test && npm --prefix sites/taobao2003 test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix sites/xhs2003 run test:e2e && npm --prefix sites/taobao2003 run test:e2e
